editor_note: None of the 9 rewritten entries changes the meaning. The qubit-layout arrays in [25], the "every fourth qubit" condition ("cada cuatro qubits") in [23], the lowest-energy-batch logic in [34] and "mismo espín" in [56] all match the English. There are two phrasing problems a native editor would fix. In [19], "como entrada" comes at the end of a long list, right after "en la sección de entrada", which is clumsy and repeats "entrada"; it should go up front ("toma como entrada el archivo..."). In [23], "tienen las puertas de dos qubits aplicadas entre ellos" copies the English passive structure; "se les aplican puertas de dos qubits" reads naturally.

examples.source: ...and the user-defined SQD options selected in the input section as input.
examples.translation: Este paso final toma el archivo Checkpoint de PySCF ... y las opciones de SQD definidas por el usuario en la sección de entrada como entrada.
examples.suggested: Este paso final toma como entrada el archivo Checkpoint de PySCF ... y las opciones de SQD definidas por el usuario en la sección de entrada.
examples.why: "como entrada" sits at the end of a long list and right after "sección de entrada", so it reads clumsily. Moving it up front removes the awkward repetition.

examples.source: the qubits corresponding to the spin orbitals with the opposite spin have the two-qubit gates applied between them
examples.translation: los qubits correspondientes a los orbitales de espín con espín opuesto tienen las puertas de dos qubits aplicadas entre ellos
examples.suggested: a los qubits correspondientes a orbitales de espín opuesto se les aplican puertas de dos qubits
examples.why: "tener X aplicadas" copies the English structure. A native technical writer would use the impersonal "se les aplican".

editor_note: Both rewritten entries keep the English meaning. Entry 2 is clean, and in entry 6 the measure-some-but-not-all caveat and the 'entrelazamiento' term are preserved. Entry 6 has some calques an editor would change. 'Una comprensión de los tipos de correlaciones… es también importante' mirrors the English noun phrase, and 'Comprender los tipos de correlaciones… también es importante' reads more naturally. 'medir algunos, pero no todos, de los sistemas individuales' has a stray 'de' and should be 'algunos de los sistemas individuales, pero no todos'.

examples.source: An understanding of the sorts of *correlations* among multiple systems ... is also important
examples.translation: Una comprensión de los tipos de *correlaciones* entre múltiples sistemas ... es también importante
examples.suggested: Comprender los tipos de *correlaciones* entre múltiples sistemas ... también es importante
examples.why: Calque of the English noun phrase. Spanish technical prose would use the infinitive here.

examples.source: choose to measure some but not all of the individual systems
examples.translation: podemos medir algunos, pero no todos, de los sistemas individuales
examples.suggested: decidimos medir algunos de los sistemas individuales, pero no todos
examples.why: 'no todos, de los sistemas' is ungrammatical because 'todos' takes the noun phrase directly. The fix also brings back the idea of choosing to measure.

editor_note: The four rewritten entries (34, 59-61) keep the English meaning and read naturally. Examples: 'salvo un factor de fase global' for 'up to a global phase', 'no nos bastan los estados mágicos sin más: necesitamos estados mágicos *codificados*', and 'destilación de estados mágicos' for 'magic state distillation'.

The nine rewritten entries are faithful overall. Neither advantage criterion (7, 8), the "by the end of 2026" timing (9, 13) or the redundant Slurm-plugin sentence in the source (21) has drifted. Entry 4 drops the hedge in "poised to bring about the dawn": "una combinación que marcará el comienzo" states the outcome as certain. This is a dropped qualifier on a closing flourish, not a technical claim. Entry 4 also uses "primitivos" where Qiskit Spanish convention is "primitivas", and entry 11 renders "most powerful path forward" as the calqued, shifted "el camino más impactante hacia adelante".

examples.source: a combination poised to bring about the dawn of quantum advantage
examples.translation: una combinación que marcará el comienzo de la ventaja cuántica
examples.suggested: una combinación destinada a marcar el inicio de la ventaja cuántica
examples.why: 'Poised to' is a hedged prediction. 'Marcará' states it as certain, which slightly strengthens the claim (a dropped qualifier).

examples.source: primitives like Sampler and Estimator
examples.translation: primitivos como Sampler y Estimator
examples.suggested: primitivas como Sampler y Estimator
examples.why: Spanish Qiskit material conventionally uses the feminine noun 'primitivas' for the primitives.

examples.source: is the most powerful path forward
examples.translation: es el camino más impactante hacia adelante
examples.suggested: es el camino más prometedor a seguir
examples.why: 'Hacia adelante' is a calque of 'forward', and 'impactante' shifts the meaning of 'powerful'. A native writer would say 'el camino a seguir' or 'la vía más potente'.

editor_note: None of the 7 rewritten entries would mislead a learner, but each of three has a small slip. In entry 16, "scenario simulation" became plain "simulación" and "relevant" disappeared from the recommendations; "scheduling" is also rendered as "programación", which in a computing text reads as "programming". In entry 50, the closing qualifier "as the technology advances" was dropped. Entries 30, 51, 53, 61 and 71 are faithful and natural, for example "valoración de opciones", "fotorresinas" and "nuevas vías para combatir el cambio climático".

examples.source: Large and complex optimization and scenario simulation problems arise in network planning, routing, scheduling, ...
examples.translation: Grandes y complejas tareas de optimización y simulación surgen en la planificación de redes, enrutamiento, programación, ...
examples.suggested: Surgen problemas grandes y complejos de optimización y simulación de escenarios en la planificación de redes, el enrutamiento, la planificación de horarios, ...
examples.why: The translation drops 'scenario', and 'programación' is ambiguous (it can mean programming) where 'scheduling' is meant. The subject-first word order is also a calque of the English.

examples.source: making timely and relevant recommendations
examples.translation: recomendaciones oportunas
examples.suggested: recomendaciones oportunas y relevantes
examples.why: 'relevant' is dropped, so the qualifier is lost.

examples.source: to harness the power of quantum for battery research as the technology advances.
examples.translation: para aprovechar las posibilidades de la computación cuántica para la investigación de baterías.
examples.suggested: para aprovechar las posibilidades de la computación cuántica para la investigación de baterías a medida que la tecnología avanza.
examples.why: The closing qualifier 'as the technology advances' is dropped. It is minor, but the English deliberately frames this as progressive.

editor_note: None of the five rewritten entries (14, 60, 78, 81, 85) changes the meaning. Entry 60 keeps the |0⟩ = vacío / |1⟩ = ocupado convention, the "addons de Qiskit" claim and the free-choice caveat. Entry 81 has two things a native editor would fix. "Esto usualmente corresponde a la creación de una matriz identidad ... y luego aplicando los operadores" breaks the parallel structure with a leftover English -ing form ("aplicando" should be "a la aplicación de"), and "orbitales core" is half-translated where "orbitales del core" or "orbitales internos" is the normal Spanish. Entries 14, 78 and 85 are fine as they are.

examples.line_approx: Esto usualmente corresponde a la creación de una matriz identidad...
examples.source: This usually corresponds to the creation of an identity matrix which represents the core (non-interacting) orbitals and then applying the creation and annihilation operators to the active space
examples.translation: Esto usualmente corresponde a la creación de una matriz identidad que representa los orbitales core (no interactuantes), y luego aplicando los operadores de creación y aniquilación al espacio activo
examples.suggested: Normalmente esto consiste en crear una matriz identidad que representa los orbitales del core (no interactuantes) y luego aplicar los operadores de creación y aniquilación al espacio activo
examples.why: The -ing form 'aplicando' is carried over from English and does not match 'a la creación'. The sentence needs parallel nouns or infinitives.

examples.source: core (non-interacting) orbitals
examples.translation: orbitales core (no interactuantes)
examples.suggested: orbitales del core (no interactuantes)
examples.why: Leaving 'core' as a bare English adjective after the noun is unidiomatic. Spanish chemistry texts write 'orbitales del core' or 'orbitales internos'.

editor_note: All 8 rewritten entries say what the English says, in natural tú-register Spanish. Terms stay consistent across them: "estado fundamental", "Hamiltoniano mezclador", "paso de Trotter", "cadenas de Pauli", and the `IIIZZ`/`ZIZII` example in entry 63 matches its setup.

I checked all 19 rewritten entries against the English and none of them changes the meaning. The dt caveat in [151], the U(1)/vacuum-state assumption in [178], the r^2 and O(r^3) scaling in [222] and the KQD applicability conditions in [226] all come through intact. The remaining problems are terminology consistency. "Quantum computer" is "computadora cuántica" in [9] and [226] (and [12] on the page), but "ordenador cuántico" in [124], [136], [143], [149], [222] and [223]. "Eigenvalue" is "autovalores" in [136] and [142], while the rest of the page uses "valores propios". The rewrites also have one calque ("circuito más superficial" for "shallower circuit" in [187]) and one stray capital, "Hamiltoniano", in [226].

examples.source: This gives a much shallower circuit than what is obtained using the generic `PauliEvolutionGate()` functionality.
examples.translation: Esto produce un circuito mucho más superficial que el obtenido con la funcionalidad genérica `PauliEvolutionGate()`.
examples.suggested: Esto produce un circuito de mucha menor profundidad que el obtenido con la funcionalidad genérica `PauliEvolutionGate()`.
examples.why: 'Superficial' is a calque of 'shallow'. The page calls deep circuits 'circuitos profundos' ([176]), so 'menor profundidad' / 'menos profundo' is the natural counterpart.

examples.source: so its eigenvalues have no particular relation to those of the full Hamiltonian
examples.translation: por lo que sus autovalores no tienen ninguna relación particular con los del hamiltoniano completo
examples.suggested: por lo que sus valores propios no tienen ninguna relación particular con los del hamiltoniano completo
examples.why: The page otherwise uses 'valores propios' / 'vectores propios' ([92], [178], [218], [222]). [136] and [142] switch to 'autovalores/autovectores'.

examples.source: To build up $\tilde{H}$ on a quantum computer requires separate measurements
examples.translation: Para construir $\tilde{H}$ en un ordenador cuántico se requieren mediciones separadas
examples.suggested: Para construir $\tilde{H}$ en una computadora cuántica se requieren mediciones separadas
examples.why: The page mixes 'computadora cuántica' ([9], [12], [226]) with 'ordenador cuántico' ([124], [136], [143], [149], [222], [223]). It should settle on one.

examples.source: The Krylov method is most useful where the Hamiltonian can be partitioned
examples.translation: El método de Krylov es más útil cuando el Hamiltoniano puede particionarse
examples.suggested: El método de Krylov es más útil cuando el hamiltoniano puede particionarse
examples.why: Everywhere else the page writes 'hamiltoniano' in lowercase; this is the only capitalized instance.

editor_note: Both rewritten entries keep the English meaning and read naturally: in entry 4, the two advantage criteria come through intact ("La validez del resultado se pueda verificar rigurosamente", "separación cuántica"), and entry 9 renders the detection caveat ("en algunos flujos de trabajo ... de forma probabilística") correctly, uses the informal "Si buscas ... consulta" and keeps "IBM Quantum Platform" in English.

All three rewritten entries are faithful and read naturally. Entry 105 renders "trace out Bob's results" as "obtener los conteos marginales de Bob en el qubit 2", which is accurate. Entry 107 keeps the causal caveat ("medición a mitad del circuito, que consume tiempo"). Entry 122 matches the CNOT/H setup (Alice's qubit as control, H on Alice's qubit) and leaves all four Bell-state mappings intact.

All four rewritten entries (13, 87, 94, 97) keep the English meaning. The metric split is intact: SABRE leads on gate count and runtime, and the AI-powered transpiler leads on two-qubit depth. The single-circuit caveat in [94] also survives, and the terms stay consistent with the rest of the page (gestores de pases, distribución y enrutamiento, compuertas, profundidad de dos qubits), with tú register ("puedes", "consulta"). Two spots read as stiff calques that a native editor would smooth. In [94], "por lo que su fidelidad es correspondientemente mucho menor" copies "correspondingly". In [87], "la parte de su objetivo ... que apunta a la profundidad del circuito" reads awkwardly, and "los dos mejores competidores" is a slightly odd way to say "strongest performers".

examples.source: so its fidelity is correspondingly much lower
examples.translation: por lo que su fidelidad es correspondientemente mucho menor
examples.suggested: por lo que, en consecuencia, su fidelidad es mucho menor
examples.why: "Correspondientemente" copies the English adverb. A Spanish technical writer would use "en consecuencia".

examples.source: the two strongest performers ... the part of its reinforcement learning objective that targets circuit depth
examples.translation: los dos mejores competidores ... la parte de su objetivo de aprendizaje por refuerzo que apunta a la profundidad del circuito
examples.suggested: los dos métodos con mejor rendimiento ... la parte de su objetivo de aprendizaje por refuerzo centrada en la profundidad del circuito
examples.why: "Apunta a" is a literal calque of "targets", and "competidores" is an odd fit for "performers". The meaning is preserved, but the phrasing is stiff.

editor_note: All 11 rewritten entries keep the English meaning. The figures (depth 15 to 6, 0.045 vs 0.075 at reps=8), the shifting argument in [126]/[127] and the appendix framing in [194] are all faithful, so nothing would mislead a learner. A native editor would still fix three calques. "par-luego-impar" in [132]/[144] is a hyphenated literal of "even-then-odd" and should be "pares y luego impares". "colapsan la profundidad de 15 a 6" in [144] calques "collapse" and should use "reducen". In [140], "aristas de vecinos más cercanos disjuntas" puts the adjective in an awkward place.

examples.line_approx: El ordenamiento par-luego-impar visita primero las aristas pares disjuntas
examples.source: The even-then-odd ordering visits disjoint even edges first
examples.translation: El ordenamiento par-luego-impar visita primero las aristas pares disjuntas
examples.suggested: El ordenamiento de pares y luego impares visita primero las aristas pares disjuntas
examples.why: 'par-luego-impar' copies the English hyphenated compound word for word. Spanish technical prose would say 'pares y luego impares' or 'primero pares, después impares'.

examples.source: both collapse the depth from 15 to 6
examples.translation: colapsan la profundidad de 15 a 6
examples.suggested: ambos reducen drásticamente la profundidad de 15 a 6
examples.why: 'colapsar la profundidad' is a calque of 'collapse'. 'Reducir drásticamente' is the idiomatic choice, and it also brings back the dropped 'both' (ambos).

examples.line_approx: al exponer aristas de vecinos más cercanos disjuntas al transpilador
examples.source: by exposing disjoint nearest-neighbor edges to the transpiler
examples.translation: al exponer aristas de vecinos más cercanos disjuntas al transpilador
examples.suggested: al exponer al transpilador aristas disjuntas entre vecinos más cercanos
examples.why: Putting 'disjuntas' after the long modifier, followed by 'al transpilador', makes the phrase hard to parse. It reads as translated rather than written in Spanish.

editor_note: None of the 31 rewritten entries would mislead a learner. The variational upper-bound argument (22, 23), the M_J product-subspace logic (31), the arity caveat (77) and the core-energy/rescaling caveat (165) all keep their meaning. The problems are consistency ones. In entry 175, "shot" becomes "disparos", but the page uses "shot(s)" everywhere else. In entry 174, "pool" becomes "la reserva de excitaciones", while every other entry keeps "pool". Entry 130's "cubre una minoría de él en lugar de todo él" reads like a calque, and entry 94's "que se mide" makes the experimental 2+ energy sound like something the reader measures.

examples.source: at finite shot count
examples.translation: con un número finito de disparos
examples.suggested: con un número finito de shots
examples.why: Everywhere else on the page, including entries 23, 30, 75 and 106, the term stays "shot". Switching to "disparos" in only this entry makes the term inconsistent.

examples.source: on a real operator from the pool
examples.translation: en un operador real de la reserva de excitaciones
examples.suggested: en un operador real del pool
examples.why: Every other entry, including the heading in entry 65, renders "pool" as "pool". Calling it "reserva de excitaciones" in just one place can make the reader think it is a different object.

examples.source: the fixed gate budget now covers a minority of it rather than all of it
examples.translation: el presupuesto fijo de puertas ahora cubre una minoría de él en lugar de todo él
examples.suggested: el presupuesto fijo de puertas ya solo cubre una parte minoritaria del pool, no su totalidad
examples.why: "una minoría de él en lugar de todo él" copies the English pronoun structure too closely and reads stiffly.

examples.source: the $2^+$ excitation energy, which is measured: $1.634$ MeV
examples.translation: la energía de excitación $2^+$, que se mide: $1.634$ MeV
examples.suggested: la energía de excitación $2^+$, que se conoce experimentalmente: $1.634$ MeV
examples.why: "que se mide" can be read as an instruction or as the tutorial's own measurement. The source means an experimentally known value.

editor_note: None of the three rewritten entries (5, 12, 57) would mislead a learner. Entry 57 keeps the English's own mismatch ("cuatro circuitos con 5, 7 y 9 pasos de Trotter"), so that is faithful and not a translation defect. Entry 5 is clean. The one change a native editor would make is in entry 12: "features" is rendered as "funciones de estimación de tiempo de QESEM". On this page, "función" already means a Qiskit Function (QESEM is "la función de Qiskit de Qedma"), so "funcionalidades" would read better and avoid the clash. The remaining terms stay consistent with the rest of the page: "retropropagación de operadores (OBP)", "disposiciones de qubits", "mitigación de errores (EM) sin sesgo" and "valores de expectación".

examples.source: using QESEM's analytical and empirical time estimation features
examples.translation: utilizando las funciones de estimación de tiempo analítica y empírica de QESEM
examples.suggested: utilizando las funcionalidades de estimación de tiempo analítica y empírica de QESEM
examples.why: On this page, "función" is the word for a Qiskit Function (QESEM itself is one). Using it for a product feature makes it sound like QESEM contains separate Functions. "Funcionalidades" avoids that clash.
